ARGUS verdict PARTIAL, 2 MAJOR:
- MAJOR-1 (RESOLVED AT SOURCE): the skill's deployment table claimed a /gauntlet 'ships via install.sh, drift-checked like any base file'. The docs say workflows are saved via the runtime /workflows->s save dialog to .claude/workflows or ~/.claude/workflows -- there is NO install.sh deploy mechanism for workflows. Fixed: reworded the skill's Deployment section to name the runtime save flow + mark install.sh-deploy-of-workflows as an open future question (not existing infra) + honesty note. Removed at source, so the (eventual) build stage inherits a clean skill.
- MAJOR-2 (folds into build): the stale cite 'install.sh:140-144' exists at 4 locations in check.sh (76/228/385/435), not 1; ADA fixes all four.

Also applied (delta-only MINORs ARGUS located): reframed the constraint table + pattern-catalog list as pointer-to-tool-description + delta, removing residual duplication.

DOC DELTAS (PRINCIPAL pasted the CURRENT workflows doc 2026-06-01; newer than the WebFetch earlier this session). Corrections the workflow-composer skill MUST fold in before forge-hardening:
1. TRIGGER KEYWORD CHANGED: 'workflow' -> 'ultracode' (as of v2.1.160; natural-language 'use a workflow' also works). The skill draft + strategy doc reference the old 'workflow' keyword — update.
2. NEW 4TH PRIMITIVE: AGENT TEAMS (lead agent supervising long-running peer sessions; shared task list; teammates keep running through interruption). Structurally CLOSER to our current PLINY-orchestrated gauntlet than workflows are. The skill's comparison framing (was 3-way subagents/skills/workflows) must become 4-way and position the Stoa gauntlet vs agent-teams vs workflows.
3. SAVED-WORKFLOW args PARAMETER: saved workflow reads global 'args'; invoke as 'Run /name on <data>'. THIS is the mechanism for the stoa--h2z remediation-workflow idea (a saved /defeat-threat taking the threat M<n> as args — reusable, parameterized per incident).
4. PERMISSION/ALLOWLIST = the stoa--x4j mechanism + fix: non-allowlisted shell/web/MCP calls STILL prompt mid-run (the silent-stall cause); file edits auto-approve (acceptEdits). Fix: pre-allowlist commands, or run claude -p / Agent SDK (no prompts). Makes stoa--x4j solvable.
5. OVERNIGHT: workflows die on session exit (resume is same-session only) — CONFIRMS dynamic workflows are NOT the unattended-overnight vehicle; remote routines (RemoteTrigger/claude.ai) are. Keep the skill's honesty note on this.
Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows as of 2026-06-01.
